description: Unit tests for the CTObjectsExtractor component in Chromium's network certificate verification, including SCT extraction, verification, and OCSP response parsing.

classes.name: CTObjectsExtractorTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing CT object extraction and verification functionalities.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes test certificates and log verifier before each test.

methods.name: ExtractEmbeddedSCT
methods.description: Extracts the embedded Signed Certificate Timestamp from a certificate.

methods.name: ExtractPrecert
methods.description: Extracts pre-certificate signed entry data from precertificate chain.

methods.name: ExtractOrdinaryX509Cert
methods.description: Extracts signed entry data from a standard X.509 certificate.

methods.name: ExtractedSCTVerifies
methods.description: Verifies that the extracted SCT correctly verifies the signed entry data.

methods.name: ComplementarySCTVerifies
methods.description: Verifies that an externally provided SCT verifies over the signed entry data.

methods.name: ExtractSCTListFromOCSPResponse
methods.description: Parses SCT list from a given OCSP response.

methods.name: ExtractSCTListFromOCSPResponseMatchesSerial
methods.description: Checks SCT list extraction correctness when serial number matches.

methods.name: ExtractSCTListFromOCSPResponseMatchesIssuer
methods.description: Checks SCT list extraction correctness when issuer ID does not match.
